text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. When building an app, one important factor is responsive design, which means the app works well on different screen sizes. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps can run on both iOS and Android. After development, apps are usually published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. Finally, performance matters a lot. Users expect apps to load quickly and run smoothly. A slow app is often deleted immediately, so developers must test and improve speed before release.
